title: These were NOT delivered in manufacturers packaging and I was VERY disappointed.
text:
These were NOT delivered in manufacturers packaging and I was VERY disappointed.. These came in a flimsy plastic baggy. I tried to put the strip on the wall so I could mount the hook and it was impossible to peel from the tape. When I did get it up, the command hook held up until I put a small
8 oz wreath on it. Within 2 hours my wreath was on the floor.

product_metadata.title: Command Medium Wall Hooks, Damage Free Hanging with Adhesive Strips, No Tools Wall Hooks for Hanging Decorations in Living Spaces, 12 Clear Wall Hooks and 24 Command Strips
features: HOLDS UP TO 2 POUNDS: One package of the Command Clear Medium Wall Hooks includes 12 clear wall hooks and 24 adhesive strips; each adhesive wall hook can hold up to 2 pounds

DAMAGE FREE HANGING: Wall hooks work without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue so you can move and rehang hats, calendars, keys, measuring spoons, cleaning tools, jewelry, brushes, kitchen utensils, dog leashes, brushes, home decor and accessories

WORKS ON A VARIETY OF SMOOTH SURFACES: Adhesive wall hangers work on a variety of smooth surfaces, including painted walls, finished wood, painted concrete cinder blocks, laminate, glass, metal and tiles

SURFACE PREP: Clean with rubbing alcohol to remove grime and dust to allow the hanging hooks to bond to the surface; the indoor temperature must be between 50 degrees Fahrenheit and 105 degrees Fahrenheit
USAGE TIPS: Wait seven days after painting before using the Command Hooks to allow paint to cure; do not hang over beds or on wallpaper; do not use the wall hooks for hanging valuable items

EASY CLEAN REMOVAL: Lightly hold the top of the wall adhesive strips and slowly pull straight down towards the floor to remove the 3M Hooks and prevent damage of walls and surfaces; reuse your hook and hardware again by purchasing refill strips
description: Command Clear Medium Wall Hooks let you decorate and organize how you want, when you want, without damaging surfaces. These clear wall hooks blend into walls and surfaces to showcase your decor. A great home improvement item, these no damage wall hooks stick on a variety of smooth surfaces without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue. Use these hanging hooks to hang hats, calendars, keys, measuring spoons, cleaning tools, jewelry, brushes, kitchen utensils, dog leashes, brushes, home decor and accessories. Simply mount these wall adhesive hooks on painted walls and more and enjoy the damage free hanging of your favorite decorations and organizers. Perfect for home renovators and college students, use these wall hooks for hanging decorations and organizers in your home, oﬃce or dorm room to elevate the appearance of your space without tools. Directions are included that show how to use the wall hangers. A clever decorating and organizing solution that doesn’t damage surfaces, these medium tool free wall hangers will help you fearlessly change your space. One package contains 12 clear wall hooks and 24 medium adhesive strips. Each single wall hanger can hold up to 2 pounds. Decorate, organize and celebrate damage free with Command.
